items.title: The Red Planet
items.text: Mars, as a passing spacecraft saw it. It waved, but nobody waved back.

items.title: Mars Bar
items.text: A whole planet of caramel in one wrapper. Not for sharing.

items.title: Helmet of Mars
items.text: The god of war, dressed to impress. That crest took all morning.

items.title: 24K Magic
items.text: Bruno Mars is pointing straight at you. You have been chosen.

items.title: Blue Sunset
items.text: On Mars the sunset is blue. The sky is just showing off.

items.title: One Bite Only
items.text: Someone took one bite and ran. The caramel saw everything.

items.title: Mars of Todi
items.text: A bronze warrior who lost his spear but kept his dignity.

items.title: Bruno on Keys
items.text: Bruno Mars at the keyboard. The piano is having the best night of its life.

items.title: Gale Crater
items.text: A rover snapped these rocky tiles. Nobody has swept here in a billion years.

items.title: Fun Size
items.text: A mini Mars bar. Fun size, they say. Too small, we say.

items.title: Capitoline Mars
items.text: A colossal god in full armour, guarding a museum in Rome. Nobody argues.

items.title: Bruno in Black & White
items.text: Bruno Mars, hat tilted just right. Even without colour, he shines.
